instruction.text: Find the steam in the image.

feedback.end: The water has evaporated. Evaporation is when a liquid becomes a gas. In this case, the water has evaporated into steam.

instruction.text: Wendy is at the park. Find the liquid that will evaporate.

feedback.end: Puddles disappearing is an example of evaporation. The water is heated by the sun and turns into a gas.

instruction.text: Select the washing on the line.

feedback.end: Clothes drying in the sun is another example of evaporation. The water on the clothes evaporates and turns into a gas.

instruction.text: Dylan is painting his nails. Select each nail to paint them.

feedback.end: Nail polish is made so that the liquid part evaporates quickly, leaving the solid colour behind.

instruction.text: Select the correct groups for the following.

hint.text: All liquids can evaporate. Some liquids evaporate more quickly than others.

feedback.end: A perfume bottle sprays tiny droplets of perfume which evaporate into gas quickly.
Juice evaporates similarly to water. It will evaporate more quickly when heated.
